provenance.dataset: sfrxUSD/reUSD LP minute candles; lp-causal-minute-v2 observation snapshot
provenance.selection: Every fourth saved task, in original order; no resampling or deduplication

history.units: prices and fees WAD; LP A uses pool A_precise scaling

config.oracle_updates: One modeled price_w per nonempty UTC minute using the latest completed block at or before the minute start
config.oracle_initialization: First historical virtual price at its actual source timestamp
config.memory_initialization: First prepared oracle and timestamp with zero fee; continued through full history

observation_preparation.oracle_state: After the row's oracle update, before trades; restore without applying the first update again
observation_preparation.quote_convention: Preserve target deployment: USD/LP Oracle consumed numerically by crvUSD AMM; Spot is crvUSD/LP

provenance.replay_initialization: Unmodified upstream calculate_loss at each compared revision. First candle open anchors liquidity and constructor memory. Prepared oracle-state arrays are not used.
provenance.scope: Historical inputs for performance/parity only. Not validation of application causal initialization or a market parameter recommendation.
provenance.access: All exact replay inputs are embedded in this file; no raw-chain collection or original dataset access is required.

initialization: Each revision's upstream calculate_loss; no application initialization adapter
